sources.entry: AQBot - Open-source desktop AI workspace for multi-provider chat, agent workflows, knowledge bases, MCP tools, and an OpenAI-compatible API gateway. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/AQBot-Desktop/AQBot) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: AQBot
summary.one_liner: AQBot is a free, open-source AI desktop client for macOS, Windows and Linux that combines multi-provider chat, agents, MCP tools, a local knowledge base and a local API gateway.
use_cases: chat with several AI models side by side
search and answer questions from private documents
run coding agents on a local folder with approval
serve configured models to Claude Code or Codex CLI
keep AI chats and API keys on your own machine
summary.what_it_does: AQBot is a desktop app for chatting with multiple AI providers, including OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen and any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, with side-by-side answer comparison and conversation branching. Agent mode can read, edit and run code in a folder with per-action approval, and an ACP workbench can drive agents such as Codex and Gemini CLI. It supports MCP servers over stdio, SSE or StreamableHTTP, plus Skills folders. Private files can be indexed into a local sqlite-vec knowledge base with optional web search. A built-in gateway exposes configured providers as OpenAI, Claude and Gemini compatible endpoints with keys, request logs and usage stats.
notable: Local API gateway that lets Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI and Cursor use configured models
Knowledge base indexed locally with sqlite-vec, with web search from Tavily, Exa, Zhipu or Bocha
App data in ~/.aqbot and user files in ~/Documents/aqbot; API keys encrypted with AES-256
Source code published on GitHub under AGPL-3.0
caveats: You must pay the model providers you connect; free only if using local models
Agent and coding-tool features depend on external agents and providers being installed or configured
